[quote=skullsbrough;60593724]Muller was slightly amused that Elbert had decided to take out a cigar in the middle of their talks, to be fair, he didn't mind a good cigar, so he wasn't judging.

"Well I thank you for your understanding. Eagerness, with everything going on over in Tallisland. It's reasonable, I suppose, we will need to be working more closely together to support the Anti-Principalist."

A helicopter similar to the one Muller arrived on land on the tarmac, seemingly the transport that had been promised. Muller seems confused, but then remembers that the road from the airport to the city is also closed, he waves of the diplomats and gets back in the helicopter he arrived in, upon stepping into the helicopter, it was clearly a military helicopter that had been scrambled to come pick them up, there was even a forgotten ammo package that it ws carying in it. They would fly to just outside of the palace of the republic, using the road meant for military parades right out of front of it as an artificial landing pad.

The Palace of the Republic had been completed in May, a little over 7 months after ground was first broken on the building on the site of the former Royal Palace in late September. It was a shiny, new, and modernist building that housed basically the entire floueschian government as work continued across the city. out front of the building was a mini public park, with fountains that surrounded a giant statue of an unnamed revolutionary soldier. Members of the Internal Republican Guard would escort them inside the building. Its interiors also followed the same modernist style; they would have to take an elevator up to the top floor of the building. Reaching the top floor, they would reach the temporary executive floor, housing all of the offices of the various government secretariats, including the first Consul. They would take them to the office of the Muller, his office was rather simple, decorated in flags and a decent view from the window, desk in the middle of the room that was large enough for small diplomatic meetings, there was a teleophone on the desk and a collection of buttons that he could use to request the presence of the various Secretariats. Tea had been left out for the diplomats. Once they sat down, Muller began to speak

"So, gentlemnen, let's get down to business then? What did you want to negotiate? As first consul. I can approve any deals we make right here."[/quote]

The two gentlemen sat down before the consul, before sliding the terms of the declaration before him.

Our requests are simple, strategic, and lasting in their entirety unto perpetuity, began Alfred.

Yes the terms are as noted in our recognition, 

1. A State of Peace shall exist between Thýven and Flousech
2. Trade shall immediately be re-established with the details of such being convened at a formal meeting between representatives of the government
3. Thýven shall permit the training and funding of the armed forces of Flousech through the procurement of bonds and loans of monetary and technical value.
4. The government of Thýven shall re-establish embassy and permit the establishment of embassy by the Second Republic.
5. The National Gold Reserve shall be granted limited annual access to the Second Republic and its government, amounting to an annual transaction amounting to 1.4% of gold therein reciprocated by trade from the Second Republic. Continued Elbert reading from a copy of the declaration.

We have brought to them the light of progress through the immense multitude of our goods and services. [list][sub][i]Xavier Almstedt[/i], in a meeting with Ascoiyan stakeholders in the Chamber of Commerce[/list][/sub][/quote]

[list][list] -| [b] Third Fed Rep. of Ascoiya [/b] - [i]" A Technological Escalation & A Well-Needed Response "[/i] |- [/list][/list]
[list][list][pre]| July of 2026, The 30th Day, Thursday // The Representative Councilate, Ascoi, Sercenzia |[/pre][/list][/list]

[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

[list] | Sounds of voices speaking would fill the air as the otherwise silent halls of the night's Councilate Hall would start to erupt with a sudden and rather drastic blaze of activity, even the solders standing guard within the entrance couldn't help but to look at each other with rather clear confusion and some began to talk amongst themselves, just as the door was opened for another time a pair of three walking into the enormous interior well kept and maintained, looking for a place to set up as one of them held a microphone, another an antenna and a third nothing but a stack of papers, Tonight would be no National Broadcast at least not a usual one as they made their way, following the crowd of Representatives and Ambassadors to the room. |

| There within sat the growing total of Government officials all from various parties, districts, affiliations and more the president leaned over the podium listening to the group of 3 talk to him, his face clearly tired, stressed and rather annoyed he'd rather be asleep by this point as he spoke everything seemed to focus onto him | [/list]

[spoiler= Non-Broadcast | Emergency Session - The Ascoiyan Representative Council | Thursday 30th July, 2026, 2:37 AM]

[list][list] [i]" And of you? Councilwoman how is Ouva? yes, I know there is a party there but... in general since the arrival of the Foreign? "[/i] [/list][/list]

[list] | The Conversation would continue for another Twenty Minutes until the clock hit 2:50am from the growing silence the podium was lightly tapped the noise quieting the room as the President himself began to speak, his voice stern yet still tired tonight was going to be filled with more paperwork again | [/list]

[list][list] [i]" I am Sorry to have all brought you here tonight, I understand much or many of you would prefer to be sleep and I understand many of you made the journey on short notice, this will be the last session for all of this month, no more will happen so let me get this over, As you know the Arrival of the Foreign has brought great and unexpected change to the nation, some good, many unusual to us, I am beginning to regret my call yet hopefully we can find a common ground, now yes... there are Unusual parties existing, creating an unusual disturbance, I understand many of you have begun to hear of the Foreign's recent introduction of unusual and strange technologies. I am aware. "

" As such, it is my goal to you, Councilors and... Reporters to declare my intentions, my administration is undergoing the processes of the formation of anew ministry, and with the blessing of the head-judge present we have begun to create legislation to try to limit the damages caused by the foreign.. these.. Self-Machines... Automation they call it yes? have brought great annoyance to many of our citizens, even I am getting many personal complaints now... and so, I present to you, the Creation of the Ministry of Technology and Development, this will do as the name says, all foreign and Zetenvian Technology will be reviewed without question before the foreign can push them into our lives, we will try to regulate and inform our populace.. and hopefully, try to learn. " |

" Yes, Councilor Natvijeso-Zeten, I understand how many of your residents here in the Ascoi Province react to the presence of Foreign banks, the head-judge will give a statement, and yes.. Councilor Adent, I get how rapidly the foreign are changing your industry in Venti, yet let us view this as a moment of opportunity, at least now it is clear that these new parties are unusual and to address we need a response, and a plan to not get caught again may we need not repeat the history of the Akan Royal Family during the Dynasty. you will all receive a paper before you leave, I need to be signed whenever possible as as for you. Reporters of the Broadcast, you are to announce our choices, from henceforth by common consensus you are the nation's voice your company will not be disrupted legislation is being put, Congratulations to the offical Zetenvian National Broadcast "[/i] [/list][/list][/spoiler]

[list] | Slowly various councilors and representatives began to leave the hall, and by tomorrow morning there was a new simple broadcast from the Radio, declaring what occurred last night in a monotone voice | [/list]

[list][list] [i][pre]" This will be a Quick announcement, Last night at 2:52 AM, the President held an Emergency session with the representive council and all current Officials this is was the result, by Decree of the President Antusidan-Zeten Quateni there is now a new Ministry of Technology & Development with the goal of researching, regulating and approving foreign technologies being introduced into Ascoiya, The Commitee for Corporate Integrity has been formalized into the Ministry of Economy as the newly named "Corporate Integrity Department" and all newly formed parties within the Provinces of; Ascoi, Ventona, Duven, Ouvo & Yatenia are to register under the Ministry of Internal Affairs, Department of Political Association. "

" As of current time, the foreign Implementation of Banking software by the Foreign Angel, Almstedt are to temporarily Cease all banking activities until approved by the Ministry of Economy as declared by Minister Asertl-Zeten Ulatero, and all foreign technologies are to first seek approval with the newly formed Ministry of Technology & Development, failure to do so is grounds for potential barring of certain granted activities and the revocation of rights. " 

" This is all from us, the Offical Zetenvian National Broadcast, your regularly scheduled broadcast will resume as normal, thank you for your time and listening "[/pre][/i] [/list][/list]

[b]July 31, 2026: A New Kingdom[/b]

The throne hall of the Royal Palace of Tharkønn was silent save for the rustling of a courtiers robes or the shuffling of a minister, the Patriarch of Thýven sat in a chair off to the side of the vacant throne, before him the two princes of Equestria, and before them a table of mahogany, which upon it were laid articles.

The day had long been planned in the halls of Thýven, though the crucial need for Equestrian support had made such a day impossible. A new kingdom had arisen on Elseyr.
